messages:
amy_sales: FYI procurement at NovaHealth flagged IAM questions as deal blockers. They want SSO metadata, proof MFA is required for admin users, RBAC export, and confirmation that service accounts cannot do console logins. Need an initial packet by EOD.

leo_security: I can draft the security narrative and include CAIQ-relevant snippets. Do they need SP or IdP metadata?

amy_sales: They asked for SP metadata and an assertion we can supply IdP endpoints if federating. Also asked for screenshots showing MFA prompts for admin login.

mike_platform: I'll pull the SP metadata from the control plane. Command I use: 
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" https://console.redwood.ai/sso/metadata/sp > redwood-sp.xml
```
I'll include cert fingerprints in the README.

tara_ops: For MFA evidence, we can export Okta events and a GIF of an admin login with MFA challenge. I'll scrub PII. Okta query: 
```bash
okta logs query 'eventType eq "user.authentication.auth_via_mfa"' --since 30d > mfa-events.json
```
I'll sanitize before sharing.

leo_security: Policy excerpt we'll attach: 
```yaml
im_policy:
  require_mfa_for_roles:
    - platform_admin
    - infra_admin
  service_accounts:
    interactive_login: false
```
Also include a paragraph on conditional access enforcement.

amy_sales: RBAC export?

mike_platform: Generated roles CSV: roles-2026-03-21.csv with columns (role, perms, scope). It includes platform_admin row showing manage_* permissions.

tara_ops: I'll produce a short service-account doc: key rotation schedule (30d), limited scopes, and no console access.

audit-bot: Note: redwood-ci build iam-docs passed.

amy_sales: Timeline pls so I can tell NovaHealth.

leo_security: Security write-up + policy snippets by 14:00 PT.

mike_platform: SP metadata + README by 15:00 PT.

tara_ops: Sanitized logs + login GIF by 16:00 PT; will upload to presigned link.

amy_sales: Great. Please drop links here once uploaded.

mike_platform: Uploaded prelim bundle to internal share: https://s3.redwood.internal/presigned/NOVA-1187/iam-evidence.zip

leo_security: Uploaded security_summary.pdf and policy_snippets.yaml

tara_ops: Uploaded mfa-events-sanitized.json and admin-login.gif (no PII).

amy_sales: Sent to NovaHealth with message: "Attached: SP metadata, MFA evidence (sanitized), RBAC export, and service-account controls. We can provide raw logs under NDA."

novahealth_procurement (via email): "Thanks. Can you confirm if MFA is enforced for all users that have any write permissions? Also include the definition of platform_admin role."

mike_platform: Reply: MFA enforcement applies to roles with write/manage permissions per policy. Attached the platform_admin row from roles CSV and policy excerpt. Service accounts do not have interactive console access.

amy_sales: Closing this blocker for now — will reopen if they ask for raw logs. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
